rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Speaker Ito reports that on that day he received from Prime Minister Hashimoto (橋本内閣総理大臣) a notice that the cabinet had decided to resign en masse.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Recorded ballot: 497 votes, majority 249; 小渕恵三 268, 菅直人 164, 神崎武法 37, 土井たか子 14, 小沢辰男 9, 武村正義 2, 3 invalid. The House designates 小渕恵三 under HR Rules art. 18(2) (recess 13:41).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: At 15:33 the Speaker reports that the House of Councillors has notified its designation of 菅直人 and, the two Houses' decisions differing, has requested a joint committee; the House's ten committee members are named by the Speaker.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The chairman of the House's joint-committee members (中川秀直) reports that neither the House of Councillors' designation of 菅直人 nor the House of Representatives' designation of 小渕恵三 won two-thirds of the members present, so no agreed plan was reached; the Speaker declares that under Constitution art. 67(2) the House's designation has become the Diet's resolution and will be reported to the Emperor forthwith under Diet Act art. 65(2).

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only. Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role in this packet: an unnamed statement, agenda or ceremony record, an acting prime minister, the House of Councillors' 1998 designee or the successor at the closing boundary. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
